activities.name: Check if any new users to add

text.value:
WITH GROUP_TABLE AS (
    SELECT ADG.ID AS GROUP_ID, ADGM.USER_ID, ADG.DISPLAYNAME FROM "RAW_PROD"."CES_ADF"."AD_GROUPS" AS ADG
    LEFT JOIN "RAW_PROD"."CES_ADF"."AD_GROUP_MEMBERS" AS ADGM
      ON ADG.ID = ADGM.GROUP_ID
    WHERE ADG.DISPLAYNAME LIKE 'Power BI - COEX%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT AD.ID
    ,GT.GROUP_ID
    ,GT.DISPLAYNAME
  FROM "COEX_PROD"."COEX_AGILOFT"."AG_COEX_EMPLOYEE_SECURITY_MAPPING" COEX
  LEFT JOIN "RAW_PROD"."CES_ADF"."AD_USERS" AS AD
    ON LOWER(COEX.COEX_LOGIN_ID) = LOWER(AD.MAIL)
  LEFT JOIN GROUP_TABLE AS GT
    ON COEX.AD_GROUP = GT.DISPLAYNAME
  WHERE COEX.DATE_UPDATED >= DATEADD(DAY ,-1,  CURRENT_DATE())
    AND AD.ID IS NOT NULL
    AND GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND COEX.ACTIVE = 1 
    AND AD_GROUP_STATUS = 'NEW'

dependsOn.activity: Check if any new users to add

expression.value: @greater(activity('Check if any new users to add').output.resultSetCount,0)

activities.name: Check if any users to deactivate

dependsOn.activity: If there are users to remove

text.value:
WITH GROUP_TABLE AS (
    SELECT ADG.ID AS GROUP_ID, ADGM.USER_ID, ADG.DISPLAYNAME FROM "RAW_PROD"."CES_ADF"."AD_GROUPS" AS ADG
    LEFT JOIN "RAW_PROD"."CES_ADF"."AD_GROUP_MEMBERS" AS ADGM
      ON ADG.ID = ADGM.GROUP_ID
    WHERE ADG.DISPLAYNAME LIKE 'Power BI - COEX%'
)
,COEX AS (
  SELECT * FROM "COEX_PROD"."COEX_AGILOFT"."AG_COEX_EMPLOYEE_SECURITY_MAPPING" COEX
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY COEX_LOGIN_ID, AD_GROUP  ORDER BY DATE_UPDATED DESC) = 1
)
SELECT
    AD.ID AS USER_ID
    ,COEX_LOGIN_ID AS LOGIN_ID
    ,CASE WHEN SUM(COEX.ACTIVE) >= 1 THEN 'ACTIVATE USER' ELSE 'DEACTIVATE USER' END AS OPERATION
    ,OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(
      'accountEnabled', CASE WHEN SUM(COEX.ACTIVE) >= 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END
    ) AS API_BODY
FROM COEX
LEFT JOIN "RAW_PROD"."CES_ADF"."AD_USERS" AS AD
  ON LOWER(COEX.COEX_LOGIN_ID) = LOWER(AD.MAIL)
LEFT JOIN GROUP_TABLE AS GT
  ON COEX.AD_GROUP = GT.DISPLAYNAME
WHERE COEX.DATE_UPDATED >= DATEADD(DAY ,-1,  CURRENT_DATE())
  AND AD.ID IS NOT NULL
  AND GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY AD.ID, LOGIN_ID
